blurb.en: Pocket drum synth with patch pins and AA batteries. Two oscillators, a noise source and a lot of noise.
blurb.fi: Taskukokoinen rumpusyna patch-piikeillä ja AA-paristoilla. Kaksi oskillaattoria, kohinalähde ja paljon meteliä.
blurb.sv: Fickstor trumsynt med patchstift och AA-batterier. Två oscillatorer, en brusgenerator och mycket oväsen.

pull.q: Based on exactly the same hardware as the Kastle with the same synth engine, but reworked into an algorithmic industrial glitch machine.

quotes.t: 8 styles of drum synthesis focusing on noise and weirdness. You have control over the sound selection, decay time, pitch control, looping modes and clocks.
It's supposed to be explored and enjoyed. It's also open source so if you want to mess it about, you can.
